answer: The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 15 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. Because the beacon beacon round is committed in advance, the nadir audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, as the reef value does not exist until the window has already shut. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
